definition:
flowchart TD
  Start([Start]) --> Parse[/Parse request/]
  Parse --> Valid{Valid?}
  Valid -- yes --> subgraph_entry
  Valid -- no --> Err[(Reject)]
  subgraph Core[Core pipeline]
    subgraph_entry[Normalize] --> Enrich[[Enrich]]
    Enrich --> Store[(Datastore)]
  end
  Store --> Done([Done])
  Err --> Done
intent: Canonical flowchart TD with multiple node shapes, subgraph, and edge labels
